title: Maslinic acid alleviates intervertebral disc degeneration by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
authors: Que, Yichen; Wong, Chipiu; Qiu, Jincheng; Gao, Wenjie; Lin, Youxi; Zhou, Hang; Gao, Bo; Li, Pengfei; Deng, Zhihuai; Shi, Huihong; Hu, Wenjun; Liu, Song; Peng, Yan; Su, Peiqiang; Xu, Caixia; Liang, Anjing; Qiu, Xianjian; Huang, Dongsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山楂酸通过PI3K/AKT和NF-kB通路缓解椎间盘退变，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is the cause of low back pain (LBP), and recent research has suggested that inflammatory cytokines play a significant role in this process. Maslinic acid (MA), a natural compound found in olive plants ( Olea europaea), has anti-inflammatory properties, but its potential for treating IDD is unclear. The current study aims to investigate the effects of MA on TNFalpha-induced IDD in vitro and in other in vivo models. Our findings suggest that MA ameliorates the imbalance of the extracellular matrix (ECM) and mitigates senescence by upregulating aggrecan and collagen II levels as well as downregulating MMP and ADAMTS levels in nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs). It can also impede the progression of IDD in rats. We further find that MA significantly affects the PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB pathways in TNFalpha-induced NPCs determined by RNA-seq and experimental verification, while the AKT agonist Sc-79 eliminates these signaling cascades. Furthermore, molecular docking simulation shows that MA directly binds to PI3K. Dysfunction of the PI3K/AKT pathway and ECM metabolism has also been confirmed in clinical specimens of degenerated nucleus pulposus. This study demonstrates that MA may hold promise as a therapeutic agent for alleviating ECM metabolism disorders and senescence to treat IDD.
abstract_zh: 椎间盘退变（IDD）是腰背痛（LBP）的病因，近期研究表明炎症细胞因子在这一过程中发挥重要作用。橄榄植物（油橄榄，Olea europaea）中发现的天然化合物马斯林酸（MA）具有抗炎特性，但其治疗IDD的潜力尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨MA对TNFα诱导的IDD在体外及其他体内模型中的影响。我们的研究结果表明，MA通过上调聚集蛋白聚糖和胶原蛋白II水平，以及下调MMP和ADAMTS水平，改善髓核细胞（NPCs）中细胞外基质（ECM）的失衡，并减轻细胞衰老。它还能阻止大鼠IDD的进展。我们进一步发现，通过RNA测序和实验验证，MA显著影响TNFα诱导的NPCs中的PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB通路，而AKT激动剂Sc-79消除了这些信号级联反应。此外，分子对接模拟显示MA直接与PI3K结合。在退变髓核的临床标本中也证实了PI3K/AKT通路功能障碍和ECM代谢异常。本研究证明，MA可能作为缓解ECM代谢紊乱和细胞衰老的治疗剂，用于治疗IDD。
